alternation.rule: day-of-year parity: even day-of-year -> health, odd day-of-year -> tech-business

audio.provider: openai-tts (scripts/generate-audio.sh, ready but disabled until OPENAI_API_KEY is added)
audio.voice_content: the top summary only, read aloud, not the full edition

tone: Neutral, concise, plain language. Explain jargon inline. No hype, no clickbait.
rules: Never invent a story, quote, statistic, or link.
Every story cites a real publication and a real URL found via web search.
Follow the active track's guidelines file exactly for structure and evidence-labeling rules.
Prefer significance and a spread of reputable sources over volume.
